verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
GGWE-ekkubo lyaffe,-era mu ggwe
Mwe twekweka-okufa
Tuyita mu ggwe,Mukama
-Okulaba Kitaffe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ggwe ow'amazima ddala
Ggwe-ogaba-okumanya;
Omatiza-ebirowoozo
Onaaza emitima.

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Tuwe-okumanya,ggwe kkubo;
Era ggwe mazima.
-Obulamu bwo bwe twetaaga,
Obw'essanyu-eringi.
